answer: Sybil resistance comes from per-identity reward vaults with randomized unlock delays. Each identity's payouts sit in its own vault; a VRF draws each unlock delay independently, and every vault pays a fixed cap per epoch. Funds cannot move between identities before unlock. A farmer running N identities locks N streams behind N random delays and burns N registration bonds in the settlement token, the opal. Caps and draws never merge; no volume discount exists. A flagged failure ripples: one frozen vault suspends siblings until re-audit. Honest users hold one vault, one delay.
